items.headline: MARA Holdings, Coinbase Global, Ternium And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Friday
items.summary: Dow Jones index gained around 350 points on Friday. MARA Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: MARA) rose sharply, while Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) also traded higher.
